import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Data {
        long totalWays, totalSum;
        Data() {
            this.totalWays = 0;
            this.totalSum = 0;
        }
        Data(long w, long s) {
            this.totalWays = w;
            this.totalSum = s;
        }
    }

    static int totalComp, totalPers, mod;
    static int[][] comb;
    static boolean[] visited2;
    static Data[] cache2;
    static boolean[][] visited1;
    static Data[][] cache1;

    static int rangeSum(int a, int b) {
        return (a + b) * (b - a + 1) / 2;
    }

    static Data calc2(int n) {
        if (n == 1) return new Data(2, 0);
        if (visited2[n]) return cache2[n];
        Data result = new Data(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            int leftCount = i;
            int rightCount = n - i - 1;
            Data leftRes = (leftCount == 0) ? new Data(1, 0) : calc2(leftCount);
            Data rightRes = (rightCount == 0) ? new Data(1, 0) : calc2(rightCount);
            int ways = (leftCount + 1) + (rightCount + 1);
            int sumAdd = rangeSum(0, leftCount) + rangeSum(0, rightCount);
            long mlt = comb[leftCount + rightCount][leftCount];
            result.totalWays = (result.totalWays + leftRes.totalWays * ways % mod * rightRes.totalWays % mod * mlt) % mod;
            result.totalSum = (result.totalSum + leftRes.totalSum * ways % mod * rightRes.totalWays % mod * mlt
                               + leftRes.totalWays * sumAdd % mod * rightRes.totalWays % mod * mlt
                               + leftRes.totalWays * ways % mod * rightRes.totalSum % mod * mlt) % mod;
        }
        visited2[n] = true;
        cache2[n] = result;
        return result;
    }

    static Data calc1(int idx, int cnt) {
        if (totalComp - idx == cnt) return calc2(cnt);
        if (visited1[idx][cnt]) return cache1[idx][cnt];
        Data res = new Data(0, 0);
        for (int i = idx; i < totalComp; ++i) {
            int leftCount = i - idx;
            int rightCount = cnt - leftCount;
            if (rightCount < 0 || rightCount > totalComp - i - 1) continue;
            Data leftRes = (i == idx) ? new Data(1, 0) : calc2(leftCount);
            Data rightRes = (i + 1 == totalComp) ? new Data(1, 0) : calc1(i + 1, rightCount);
            long mlt = comb[leftCount + rightCount][leftCount];
            res.totalWays = (res.totalWays + leftRes.totalWays * rightRes.totalWays % mod * mlt) % mod;
            res.totalSum = (res.totalSum + leftRes.totalSum * rightRes.totalWays % mod * mlt
                            + leftRes.totalWays * rightRes.totalSum % mod * mlt) % mod;
        }
        visited1[idx][cnt] = true;
        cache1[idx][cnt] = res;
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int ncomp = sc.nextInt();
        int npers = sc.nextInt();
        int MOD = sc.nextInt();

        totalComp = ncomp;
        totalPers = npers;
        mod = MOD;

        comb = new int[ncomp + 1][ncomp + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= ncomp; ++i) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            comb[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j) {
                comb[i][j] = (comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
            }
        }

        visited2 = new boolean[ncomp + 1];
        cache2 = new Data[ncomp + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= ncomp; ++i) {
            cache2[i] = new Data();
        }

        visited1 = new boolean[ncomp + 1][npers + 1];
        cache1 = new Data[ncomp + 1][npers + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= ncomp; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= npers; ++j) {
                cache1[i][j] = new Data();
            }
        }

        System.out.println(calc1(0, npers).totalSum);
        sc.close();
    }
}
